rule: Preserve V38 geometry, position targets and reference slew. For a limb whose existing scheduled command phase is in 0..72 inclusive, both current native-derived contact booleans explicitly say absent (presence=false and bears_support=false), both previous/current wave snapshots are active, and dt>0, use the bounded full finite difference of that joint's actual slewed position reference. Otherwise use V38's pose-separated wave rate exactly. This is a development tracking hypothesis, not a new landing predicate, timer, force-aware recovery or predicted complete fix.

formula.wave_reference_rate: V38's bounded same-current-pose, same-floor, same-slew-origin comparison between current and previous wave inputs; zero on initialization or either inactive wave.
formula.airborne_selection: dt>0 AND previous_wave.active AND current_wave.active AND 0<=current_scheduled_phase<=72 AND presence is explicitly false AND bears_support is explicitly false. Both joints of one limb share this selection.
formula.airborne_reference_rate: clamp((r_new-r_previous)/dt,-current_cap,current_cap). Use only for the explicit airborne selection.
formula.selected_reference_rate: airborne_reference_rate when selected; otherwise exactly wave_reference_rate.
formula.final_motor_velocity: The existing selected speed clamp and motor-direction sign -1.0; preserve force limits, position/slew bounds and truthful saturation.

contact_contract.source: The already validated, same-model/same-step canonical ordered_contact_observations. No new read, inferred force, geometry-based contact predicate, or extra sensor.
contact_contract.identity: Exact compiled limb/contact-site order. Missing or malformed observations retain existing fail-closed state validation; never interpret missing, unknown or malformed as absent.
contact_contract.ambiguous_contact: Any presence=true or bears_support=true retains the V38 rate. This selector must not equate non-bearing contact with airborne.
contact_contract.timing: The contact observation is pre-command; do not use post-command trace values or look ahead to a recorded touchdown.

memory_contract.identity: Distinct V39 identity. Reuse V38 support-reference positions/time and previous-wave snapshot semantics with no new learned or integrated state.
memory_contract.initialization: Preserve neutral first reference and zero initial/activation feedforward. Retain both-wave-active requirement.
memory_contract.update: Store exactly the same current upstream wave snapshot and positions/time as V38; no hidden phase reset or same-input memory divergence except policy memory identity.

required_receipt: Distinct top-level/profile/memory identities and mode, V38 wave snapshots and comparison references, selected ordered reference rates, explicit per-limb airborne-selection and pre-command contact provenance, and bounded full-reference rates sufficient to reconstruct every chosen joint rate. Old policies omit any new optional fields byte-exactly.
preserve: All V38 actual position goals, feasible-support plans, reference slew and all gains, speed/force and joint limits.
Exact V38 velocity output whenever the airborne selector is false, including all supported contacts, ambiguous/non-bearing contacts and scheduled stance.
Existing phase clocks, release/recontact/phase-sync gates, dwell counts, held landing and native contact truth.
V20 standing recovery, stance V7, BW5R-B prefix and every older policy's raw output bytes.
Explicit static floor provenance, original evaluator/thresholds, seed partition, 400 resumed commands, 986-step tail and 1338-step child cap.
required_zero_world_checks: Selector truth table: active/inactive, initialization/dt=0, phases 0/72/73/359, explicit absent contact, presence-only and bearing-only cases, malformed and crossed state refusal.
Full-rate formula and caps, same-slew endpoints, retained V38 rate for unselected joints, old neutral startup and activation behavior.
All 400 saved V38 inputs through real stateless and stateful exports with the new memory chained, not independent per-row resets.
Same-input V38 comparison: exact position references, plans, gait memory and unselected motor command fields; only declared selected velocity outputs, new identity and receipt may differ.
Independent reconstruction of every selector, full reference rate, V38 fallback rate, and final motor velocity. Preserve exact input precision.
Byte-exact predecessor policies and recovery fixtures. Use a distinct non-runnable component before explicit shared-route integration.
risks: The extra rate includes direct pose-driven correction and target catch-up during selected airborne motion. Switching as contact appears/disappears can produce abrupt bounded velocity changes.
120 saturated commands in the saved-input sketch versus V38's 19 is not a forecast of native saturation, contact quality, or success. Speed limits do not establish acceleration or impact bounds.
This branch does not directly repair the 17 observed stance-phase contact losses, unreachable stance targets, or inadequate-relocation cycles. Those remain explicit blockers.
Faster airborne tracking may change later body pose and contact timing for better or worse. Frozen-input arithmetic cannot establish the next trajectory.
Native contact absence does not mean a limb is dynamically unloaded in every sense; no force estimate or general force-aware recovery is claimed.
Do not extend the horizon or relax gates if the next run leaves a cycle incomplete. Any later scope change needs its own prospective adequacy argument.
